title: unified-rollouts-probing-staged-shadow-autorollback-workflow
author: Ethan Zhao
ci_checks: integration-tests: failed (timeout on first run) - rerun passed
body: Motivation: Improve safety and observability for staged shadow + probing rollouts by introducing a coordinated workflow that runs probing jobs, collects quorum metrics, and triggers automated rollbacks when composite metric thresholds are violated. This change is part of the Unified Rollouts initiative (ENG-8421) and aims to reduce blast radius for new model variants while preserving fast ramping for low-risk changes. Summary of changes: - Add a new probing-staged-shadow workflow in the rollouts service that sequences probe runs, waits for quorum, and evaluates composite metric rules. - Introduce a lightweight probe scheduler to avoid thundering-herd issues when running parallel probes across hosts. - Extend the autorollback engine to support multi-metric quorum decisions and transient-quarantine windows. - Add observability hooks and dashboard snippets for rollback reasons, probe health, and quorum progress. - Add e2e tests and stability guards to mitigate flakiness (retry/backoff and Canary->Shadow handoff checks). Checklist: - [x] Implementation of probing workflow - [x] Unit tests for scheduler and quorum logic - [x] Integration tests for workflow orchestration - [x] e2e tests covering rollback paths - [x] Docs updated for rollout config (probing/quarantine parameters) Migration notes: Existing rollout specs are backwards compatible; new fields (probing.quorum, probing.window_ms, rollback.quarantine_ms) are optional with safe defaults. Ops runbook: when a rollback fires, the console will show a detailed reason including metric deltas and probe quorum count. If integration tests fail with timeouts, up the probe timeout or increase the probing.window_ms for noisy environments.

review_threads: Harper Lin: Nice design. Two asks: (1) make quorum configurable per-rollout and (2) ensure probe scheduler backoff is parametrized. - Reply(Ethan): both added, quorum defaults to 0.66 and window is configurable.
Diego Martinez: Integration test flaked locally due to timing; please add stability guard with retry/backoff. - Reply(Ethan): added guard and increased test timeouts; CI e2e passed on rerun.
Sophie Kim: Can we expose rollback reason codes to the console API? - Reply(Ethan): added rollback_reason field to rollout status and dashboard snippet updated.
Harper Lin: LGTM after addressing comments. Approved.

release_notes: Add probing-staged-shadow rollout workflow with composite-metric quorum autorollback. New rollout config keys: probing.quorum (float), probing.window_ms (int), rollback.quarantine_ms (int). Improved observability for rollback reasons and probe health.
